notes.title: No Sleep For Kaname Date - From AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES Coming to Steam on July 25
notes.content:
No Sleep For Kaname Date - From AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES, a new entry in the AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES series is coming to Steam on July 25.*

About No Sleep For Kaname Date - From AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES
The player takes on the role of Kaname Date, the protagonist, and once again teams up with the AI-Ball, Aiba, to tackle a mysterious case and rescue Iris, an internet idol who has been forced to take part in a dangerous escape game. No Sleep For Kaname Date - From AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES introduces a new gameplay element: "Escape". As with previous games, in "Investigation", players will examine crime scenes and listen to testimonies. In "Somnium", players enter the dream worlds of suspects and key witnesses. In the new "Escape" sections, players will solve puzzles to break out of locked rooms. By moving between these three sections, players can obtain the necessary clues to solve the case.

A day after The New Cyclops Serial Killings was resolved, internet idol Iris Sagan (known as "A-set") is abducted by a UFO and forced to participate in a perilous escape game called The Third Eye Game. Meanwhile, in another part of the city, a mysterious device is discovered. It resembles a coffin, and attached to it is a note that reads:

"Psync me"

Relying on a tenuous line of communication with the missing Iris, one man rises once again, determined to track down the UFO that should not even exist. Together with his partner, the AI-Ball Aiba, he sets out on a quest. That man...is Special Agent Kaname Date.

The game's director Kazuya Yamada (Spike Chunsoft) is writing the scenario, with Kotaro Uchikoshi, the previous scenario writer, overseeing as the series director. Yusuke Kozaki returns as character designer, and Keisuke Ito continues as the music composer.

Wishlist from the store page link below and get notified on release day!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2752180
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3603750

A special edition featuring a collectible Steam key card and holographic stickers is now available for pre-order from Spike Chunsoft, Inc.'s official store. Additionally, a physical version of the soundtrack is also up for pre-order. Visit the links below for more details:
US Store
UK Store
EU Store

A message from the creators:
Series Director / Scenario Supervisor: Kotaro Uchikoshi
For this title, I'm serving as the "scenario advisor" from the perspective of overseeing the entire series. From the beginning, I trusted the development staff, but I was filled with awe at the quality, which far exceeded my expectations.
The core element of this game, the "escape game," is not just a collection of puzzles; it has been intricately woven with a deep thematic significance, and its difficulty is perfectly balanced…! I believe both core and casual players will definitely enjoy it.
This game is a heartfelt anthem of love created by the staff who love the "AI" series, for all the fans who also love the "AI" series.

Director/Scenario Writer Kazuya Yamada
I am Kazuya Yamada, the director and scenario writer for this project.
We've been able to bring this title to you thanks to all of you who said, "I want to see Date as the protagonist once again." Thank you so much.
As we considered how to make this title as satisfying as possible, we ended up cramming so much into it that it caused a lot of trouble for the development team. However, because of that, we believe we've created a title that everyone will enjoy. So please look forward to it.

Check out the past entries into the AI: The Somnium File series from the links below!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/948740/AI/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1449200/AI/
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/26260/AI/

*The release time will be 12am PT.

notes.title: [PATCH NOTES]8/4/2016
notes.content:
Patch V 1.1 was released today.

PATCH NOTES
• Fixed bug where BGM and voices would randomly stop. 
• Fixed white screen freeze after solving certain puzzle rooms. 
• Fixed flickering in certain puzzle rooms

If you are still experiencing issues after the patch, or if the patch introduced new issue, please let us know on the forums. 
This patch overrides the Beta branch and the Beta has been closed with this update. 

Thank you for your patience and understanding.

notes.title: [BETA PATCH NOTES] 7/12/2016
notes.content:
Beta Patch V 1.1 was released today.

This optional Beta is intended for users experiencing the following issues:

PATCH NOTES
     Fixed bug where BGM and voices would randomly stop.
     Fixed white screen freeze after solving certain puzzle rooms.
 
To access the Beta branch, open the Steam Launcher. Then go to:

Library > Right click on “Zero Escape: Zero Time Dilemma” > Properties > Beta > From drag-down menu, select: patch_100 – Patch V 1.1

We are still looking into other major issues reported by players. If you experience issues due to the Beta patch, please let us know on the forums. 

Thank you for your patience and understanding

notes.title: Price and Bonus Items
notes.content:
Zero Escape: Zero Time Dilemma  arrives on Steam on June 30 for 39.99 USD.
Early orders come with an exclusive mini-OST and premium booklet.

The Steam port supports trading cards and includes 5 cards, 3 backgrounds and 5 emoticons. 
 http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/270593642716066405/B5C8B73C08E1CA55FB79CDF797C6CB1FD33C73EE/ 

[Premium Booklet Details]
 http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/270593642719642955/27A840711BDC1F415231744FB2C0AD9681F6091E/?interpolation=lanczos-none&output-format=jpeg&output-quality=95&fit=inside|736:1024&composite-to=*,*|736:1024&background-color=black
What happened during the cohabitation experiment at Dcom before the events of the game? Series director Kotaro Uchikoshi takes you into the minds of the cast with this collection of vignettes. 

This 48-page booklet also includes illustrations and design documents with comments from character designer Rui Tomono, a summary of the Zero Escape series and original puzzles.

[Bonus Mini-OST Details]
Contains MP3 and FLAC files. 
12-song mini-soundtrack.

All songs written by Zero Escape series composer Shinji Hosoe. 

Contains MP3 and FLAC files. 

Complete Track Listing: 

01. Zero Times
02. Quondam Monitors
03. Ustulate Pathos
04. Tough Decision
05. Trash Disposal
06. Glacial Solitude
07. Transient Tranquility
08. Unliberated Library
09. Nostalgic Scenery
10. Sacrificial Demise
11. Extreme Urgency
12. Interminable Dilemma
